en: This is a multi-view postcard showing four different landmarks in the city of Graz. The images depict (top left) the Kaiser Franz Josef-Kai with the Schlossberg hill and its clock tower, (top right) the K.k. Universität (Imperial and Royal University), (bottom left) the Hauptplatz (main square), and (bottom right) the Stadttheater (city theater). The postcard is visually characterized by hand-tinted colorization and contains German text labeling each view.
